# Josty

> Small, auditable, keyless metasearch CLI & Agent Skill.

## Agent Skill Installation
Copy `.agents/skills/josty/SKILL.md` into your agent's skills directory (e.g. `.agents/skills/josty/`, `~/.claude/skills/josty/`, or `~/.gemini/antigravity/custom_skills/josty/`).

## Execution
- Instant execution: `uvx josty "<query>" --limit 10`
- CLI package install: `pipx install josty`
- Fallback runner: `$(command -v python3 || command -v python) .agents/skills/josty/scripts/run.py "<query>"` (thin delegator; installs josty from PyPI on first use)

## Key Options
- `--limit <n>`: Number of results (default: 10)
- `--site <domain>`: Add domain filter (repeatable up to 5 times)
- `--max-query-variants <n>`: Cap maximum query variants generated by mode and site expansion
- `--fetch`: Extract clean, bounded Markdown from the top pages
- `--profile <general|dev|academic>`: Domain ranking profile boosting authoritative sources
- `--mode <plain|exact|oss>`: Search query optimization mode
- `--diagnose`: Probe HTTPS homepage reachability of search backend hosts (transport only; not search health)
- `--cache-stats`: Print local cache statistics (rows, bytes, hits) and exit

## Output Guarantees
`stdout` is strictly versioned JSON conforming to the josty schema contract. All diagnostic logs and warnings are directed to `stderr`.
